title.narrative: Life-Saving GBV Response and Prevention Initiative in Eastern Tigray (Adigrat, Erob, Zala Anbesa, Gulomekeda Woredas)

description.narrative: ltpgtltbrgtThe scale and intensity of the damages done throughout the two-year war in Tigray have been much deeper in women ending up in SGBV survivors. Experts estimate that GBV was committed against at least 40 to 50 percent of women and girls in the Tigray and other affected regions of Ethiopia. Further, approximately 80 percent of cases reported rape, and over 90 percent of cases were perpetrated against underage girls. However, these victims have never received enough mental health and psychological support, social and economic rehabilitation support and most of them are still under traumatic conditions and highly involved in negative coping mechanisms in the target intervention areas. Adigrat, Erob, Zala Anbesa and Gulomekeda Woredas have experienced all the ordeals of the conflict induced GBV crisis while lagging to get adequate responses identified as hotspot areas on account of their location neighboring where protection services has not still been adequately addressed. The Protection cluster as well as GBV AOR of Tigray identified those as priority areas that need emergency response services to address the crisis in these areas. Due to the damages of the health facilities, the provision of essentials of Sexual and Reproductive Health (SRH) Services is very limited. ltbrgtThe scope of intervention of the project entails addressing the basic protection needs of the affected population by responding to the critical GBV as well as essentials of SRH service gaps in the areas. Mums for Mums have existing presence in the target woredas and extensive experience in Protection, GBV, MHPSS, being active member of the Protection Cluster at regional level. The scope of intervention would be focused on:ltbrgtGeneral Protection Cluster ltbrgt1. Protection monitoringltbrgt2. Cash interventions to minimize exposure to protection risks and negative coping mechanismsltbrgt3. Vulnerability screeningltbrgtGBV AoRltbrgt1. GBV case management integrating sexual reproductive health (SRH)ltbrgt2. Mental Health and Psychosocial support (MHPSS), and psychological first aid (PFA) support ltbrgt3. Emergency Cash Assistance to facilitate referral for specialized services ltbrgt4. Dignity kits for women and girls of reproductive age ltbrgt5. Establishment of Women and Girls Friendly Spaces (WGFS) and capacity building for One-stop Centers, to strengthen referrals ltbrgt6. Awareness-raising activities ltbrgtThese activities will complement other on-going projects implemented by Mums for Mums in the same locations with other funding sources, to ensure the critical gaps in terms of Protection and GBV are properly addressed, with no duplication of effort and resources. This project has also been endorsed by the Protection Cluster Coordinator in Tigray region, and designed in collaboration with local authorities and other stakeholders on the ground, to ensure a smooth implementation and strong coordinationltbrgtlt/pgt
